items.title: Why is the x86 undefined instruction called ud2? Why 2?

items.title: A Quantitative Evaluation Framework for Temporal Explainability in Echocardiographic Video Segmentation
items.title_zh: 超声心动图视频分割中时间可解释性的定量评估框架
items.summary: 提出一个定量评估 Grad-CAM 解释的框架，用四个互补指标衡量时间一致性、显著区域运动、解剖重叠和时间重叠。在 EchoNet-Dynamic 上比较 2D U-Net 与不同时间步长的 ConvLSTM U-Net，发现分割性能相当，但中间层 ConvLSTM 解释的显著一致性明显更低、质心运动更大；Temporal Bottleneck 解释在各步长下都显著比 Encoder Bottleneck 稳定。作者据此指出逐帧解释指标无法区分有意义的时间特征演化与解释不稳定。

items.title: EAR: Entity-Aware Partitioning Approach for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Development
items.title_zh: EAR：面向检索增强生成开发的实体感知划分方法
items.summary: EAR is an entity-aware partitioning approach for retrieval-augmented multiple-choice QA that extracts normalized surface anchors from the question, answer options and corpus, then retrieves local windows around matching anchors and can attach a larger parent passage via an extractive summary. On a cleaned 153-question MMLU-style subset with Mistral, Gemma and DeepSeek, entity-window retrieval cut retrieved words by 37.5-40.2% relative to chunks, while accuracy changes were mixed and not statistically significant.

items.title: Accurate Models of AMD Matrix Cores
items.title_zh: AMD 矩阵核心的精确建模
items.summary: The authors characterize the numerical behavior of matrix multipliers across three AMD GPU architectures (CDNA 1, CDNA 2 and CDNA 3), designing test vectors for every supported input format to determine features such as accumulator width, rounding behavior and special-input handling. They develop MATLAB-based software models for each architecture, validate them for bit-level reproducibility against hardware on 10 million randomized input sets, and use them to quantify application-level accuracy differences versus NVIDIA tensor cores.

items.title: BanglaMemeX: Advancing Cultural Metaphoric Image Interpretation in Bangla with a Multimodal Explainable Dataset
items.title_zh: BanglaMemeX：以多模态可解释数据集推进孟加拉语文化隐喻图像理解
items.summary: 提出 BanglaMemeX，一个文化根基明确的多模态基准，包含 3,000 个孟加拉语网络模因，标注了幽默、讽刺、冒犯性、激励意图和整体情感等多维标签，并附有人工撰写的解释以显式描述文字与视觉隐喻。作者在分类和解释生成两类任务上系统评估现代 VLM，发现尽管表层准确率尚可，模型仍难以解读隐含的文化线索。

items.title: RoMa-$Ω$: What Feed-Forward 3D Models Know About Image Matching
items.title_zh: RoMa-Ω：前馈三维模型对图像匹配了解多少
items.summary: 分析前馈三维重建模型对图像匹配的掌握程度，考察三条路径：patch 特征的零样本匹配、三维点预测的直接匹配，以及在学得表示上训练完整匹配器。作者发现这类模型虽在零样本匹配上表现较差（尤其在较深层），却能为线性探测和完整匹配流水线提供强表示，其原始预测在中等视角变化和模态差异下也具备竞争力；据此用 VGGT-Ω 替换 RoMa v2 的 DINO 主干得到 RoMa-Ω，在 WxBS 上比 RoMa v2 高 8.1 mAA。

items.title: GTA: Graph Theory Agent and Benchmark for Algorithmic Graph Reasoning with LLMs
items.title_zh: GTA：面向 LLM 算法图推理的图论智能体与基准
items.summary: The authors introduce GT Bench, a benchmark of 24 classical graph problems in 44 task-structure settings with over 100,000 examples across four input representations, and find that LLM accuracy is strongly tied to representation and shifts with graph density, size and topology. They also propose GTA, which pairs a preference-trained representation selector with plan-and-decompose scaffolding around a frozen executor LLM, lifting Phi-4 from 53.5% to 69.1% on the easy split and from 33.0% to 41.5% on the hard split.

items.title: 3D Gait-Based Autism Classification Using Attention-Enhanced Deep Learning with Cross-Fold Statistical Stability Analysis
items.title_zh: 基于注意力增强深度学习与交叉折叠统计稳定性分析的三维步态自闭症分类
items.summary: The study proposes an attention-enhanced Transformer framework for autism spectrum disorder classification from 3D gait features, evaluated on precomputed statistical gait descriptors and raw biomechanical ground-reaction-force measurements. Under five-fold cross-validation it reports 99.00% accuracy on the public Kinect-based benchmark and mean 95.00% accuracy on an independent private force-plate dataset.

items.title: Route, Don't Fix: Regime-Dependent Decoding Correction and a Trajectory-Gated Router for Reliable Clinical LLM Answer Selection
items.title_zh: 路由而非修正：面向可靠临床 LLM 答案选择的机制依赖解码修正与轨迹门控路由器
items.summary: The authors observe that a fixed inference-time logit correction that gains about ten percentage points on a truthfulness stress test yields negligible gains on clinical multiple-choice benchmarks, and propose ALTAS, which reads terminal entropy and late-layer linearity from one forward pass to choose per question between greedy decoding and late-layer trajectory correction. Gated per question, it retains gains of 8.3 to 9.5 percentage points on TruthfulQA while keeping MedQA, PubMedQA and MedHallu within a one-percentage-point do-no-harm band, adding 6.5% latency overhead.
